content:
Since the point is chosen uniformly from the disk, the probability equals the area fraction of the shaded sector. Because the sector is centered at \(O\), this is its central angle divided by \(360^\circ\).

The lower semicircle is a \(180^\circ\) angle, partitioned into angles
\[
30^\circ,\quad x,\quad 65^\circ,\quad 40^\circ,
\]
where \(x\) is the central angle of the shaded sector. Thus
\[
x=180^\circ-(30^\circ+65^\circ+40^\circ)=45^\circ.
\]
Therefore,
\[
P=\frac{45}{360}=\frac18.
\]
